hook: Son founded SoftBank in 1981 and built it into a global technology holding company. Through SoftBank's 2016 acquisition of Arm, where he now serves as chairman, and his role as chairman of the Stargate data center program announced in 2025, Son has become one of the largest capital allocators in AI infrastructure.
name: Masayoshi Son
moniker: Founder, Chairman and CEO, SoftBank Group

reading.body:
Masayoshi Son controls three critical nodes in AI infrastructure: Arm's chip design, SoftBank's capital allocation, and the Stargate Project's data center buildout announced in 2025.

Son's ownership of Arm means he influences the processor architecture underlying both training hardware and edge deployment. His attempted 2022 sale to Nvidia failed, leaving him retaining and then taking Arm public in 2023. This kept Arm independent at a moment when chip design became inseparable from AI capability. SoftBank's role as a majority shareholder in Arm after the 2016 acquisition gave Son direct leverage over processor roadmaps precisely when AI workloads were reshaping compute demands.

The Stargate chairmanship amplifies this control into infrastructure itself. A joint venture with OpenAI, Oracle, and MGX to build large-scale data centers directly addresses the constraint this site identifies: buildings and power. Son is now positioned to shape not just what chips are designed, but where and how they are powered and deployed. This vertical span, from chip instruction sets through data center capacity, is unusual among individual investors.

What this does not show is execution. The timeline documents announcements and transactions, not whether Arm's designs will meet AI training demands or whether Stargate projects will deliver capacity on schedule and budget. Capital allocation and infrastructure control are prerequisites for scaling AI compute, but not guarantees of it.

primary.name: SoftBank Group Corp., Biography: Masayoshi Son

timeline.event: Founds Nihon SoftBank, later SoftBank Group Corp.
timeline.impact: Establishes the company as a software distributor and publisher

timeline.event: SoftBank completes its acquisition of Arm Holdings
timeline.impact: Son becomes Chairman and Executive Director of Arm

timeline.event: SoftBank's proposed sale of Arm to Nvidia is abandoned amid regulatory objections
timeline.impact: SoftBank retains and later lists Arm

timeline.event: Becomes Chairman and Director of Arm Holdings following its U.S. IPO
timeline.impact: Continues to lead Arm's board after its public listing

timeline.event: Named chairman of The Stargate Project with OpenAI, Oracle and MGX
timeline.impact: Positions SoftBank as a lead backer of a large-scale U.S. AI data center program

quick_facts: Founder, Representative Director, Chairman and CEO of SoftBank Group Corp., which he founded in 1981
Chairman of Arm Holdings plc since 2023, and Chairman and Executive Director of Arm from September 2016
SoftBank completed its acquisition of Arm Holdings in September 2016 for roughly 3.3 trillion yen
Named chairman of the Stargate Project, an AI infrastructure joint venture with OpenAI, Oracle and MGX, announced in January 2025

achievements.title: Founder, SoftBank Group
achievements.impact: Built a software distribution company founded in 1981 into a global technology and investment holding company.

achievements.title: Chairman, Arm Holdings
achievements.impact: Leads the chip design company that SoftBank acquired in 2016, following an attempted sale to Nvidia that was abandoned in 2022 and Arm's 2023 U.S. IPO.

achievements.title: Chairman, The Stargate Project
achievements.impact: Heads the AI infrastructure joint venture formed with OpenAI, Oracle Corporation and MGX, announced in January 2025.
